description: "The Isle of Palms, and Other Poems" by John Wilson is a collection of poetry written in the early 19th century. The principal poem, "The Isle of Palms," narrates an emotive tale of love, loss, and hope against the backdrop of a mystical sea voyage and a serene island paradise.
